V-11.detail: 200/200 formal points dark with a complete horizon (100.0%; criterion >= 99%), 0 lit, 0 inconclusive (incomplete terrain coverage: not scored, never counted as dark)

criterion: share of sampled interior PSR points with zero sunlight >= 0.99

scoring.rule: passed if dark/n >= 0.99; failed if (dark + inconclusive)/n < 0.99; otherwise inconclusive. Only points with a complete horizon are scored.

coverage.source: PGDA 90 product page: "LAT gives the latitude limit (80S, ...)"; the 20 m products "cover 80 - 90 deg South"
coverage.rule: a cell is used only if all four corners lie at or south of the limit; the interior margin then also applies from the limit
